judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The terse mentor voice ('Sorry about the stench, lad', 'This may get very ugly, lad'), the practical briefing on spells handed over for the infiltration, 'Good luck and good speed' and the flat journal line all match the campaign's chapter openings, including the sneak-in-for-the-halberd setup.
